note: A 10 x 10 x 2 slab (z -1..1), a 2 x 2 x 4 post at (3, 3) (z 0..4), `hole(1)` on its top. The plane is the post's top, z = 4, with the parent origin on it, so the hole is at (0, 0) and starts in the air: it bores the slab only (2 deep). The union has V = 200 + 16 - 4 (the post's lower metre is inside the slab) and A = 280 - 4 + 24 + 4; the hole takes pi r^2 2 of volume, two discs of area and adds 2 pi r 2 of wall.
